index_name: Circular Dependency Test Index (plugin dependency resolution fixture)

plugins.name: LoopA
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: First link of a 3-entry dependency cycle (loopa -> loopb -> loopc -> loopa). Installing this must fail cleanly - and install nothing - because the dependency graph cycles back to loopa before InstallEntry is ever reached.

plugins.name: LoopB
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Depends on loopc, which depends back on loopa - so the cycle isn't just a direct mutual pair.

plugins.name: LoopC
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Depends on loopa, closing the cycle.
